name: FactorSplat
definition: A per-scene N-dimensional Gaussian splatting (N-DGS) proxy that accepts region-specific intensity-to-RGBA transfer function (TF) curves at inference time, allowing appearance changes without retraining or refitting.
summary: FactorSplat is a Gaussian splatting proxy that decouples geometry from appearance, enabling instant transfer function changes without retraining.
